source.text: לְדָוִ֗ד מִ֫זְמ֥וֹרלַֽ֭יהוָה הָאָ֣רֶץ וּמְלוֹאָ֑הּ תֵּ֝בֵ֗ל וְיֹ֣שְׁבֵי בָֽהּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Of David. A psalm. To YHWH [belongs] the earth and its fullness, [the] world and those who dwell in it.

en.L: Of David. A psalm. To {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} [belongs] the earth and its fullness, the world and those who dwell in it.
en.B: Of David. A psalm. The earth is {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s, and all that fills it, the world and everyone who lives there.
en.R: By David. A song. The earth belongs to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and so does everything in it. The world and all the people who live in it belong to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.

fr.L: De David. Un psaume. {{divine_name:Au SEIGNEUR|À Yahvé}} [appartient] la terre et ce qui la remplit, le monde et ceux qui l’habitent.
fr.B: De David. Un psaume. La terre est {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, avec tout ce qui la remplit, le monde et tous ceux qui y vivent.
fr.R: De David. Un chant. La terre appartient {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, et tout ce qu’elle contient aussi. Le monde et tous les gens qui y vivent sont à {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.

sw.L: Ya Daudi. Zaburi. Dunia [ni] ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, na vyote viijazavyo, ulimwengu na wale wakaao ndani yake.
sw.B: Ya Daudi. Zaburi. Dunia ni mali ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, pamoja na kila kitu kinachoijaza, ulimwengu na kila mtu anayeishi humo.
sw.R: Ya Daudi. Wimbo. Dunia ni ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, na vivyo hivyo kila kitu kilichomo. Ulimwengu na watu wote wanaoishi ndani yake ni mali {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.

es.L: De David. Salmo. {{divine_name:Al SEÑOR|A Yahvé}} [pertenece] la tierra y lo que la llena, el mundo y los que viven en él.
es.B: De David. Salmo. La tierra es {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y todo lo que hay en ella, el mundo y todos los que lo habitan.
es.R: De David. Canto. La tierra le pertenece {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, y también todo lo que hay en ella. El mundo y toda la gente que vive en él son {{deity_pronoun:suyos|Suyos}}.

vi.L: Của Đa-vít. [Một] thi thiên. Đất và mọi vật đầy dẫy trên đất [thuộc về] {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, thế giới và những người cư ngụ trong đó.
vi.B: Của Đa-vít. Thi thiên. Đất và muôn vật trên đất đều thuộc về {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, cả thế giới và mọi người sống trong đó.
vi.R: Của Đa-vít. Bài ca. Trái đất thuộc về {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và mọi vật trên đất cũng vậy. Thế giới và mọi người sống trong đó đều thuộc về {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 다윗의 시. 땅과 그것에 가득한 것이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 [속하고], 세상과 그 안에 사는 사람들도 [그러하다].
ko.B: 다윗의 시. 땅과 거기 가득한 모든 것, 세상과 그 안에 사는 모든 사람이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 것이다.
ko.R: 다윗이 지은 노래. 땅은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 것이다. 땅 위의 모든 것도 그분의 것이다. 세상과 그 안에 사는 모든 사람이 그분의 것이다.

pt.L: De Davi. Salmo. {{divine_name:Do SENHOR|De Javé}} [é] a terra e a sua plenitude, o mundo e os que moram nele.
pt.B: De Davi. Salmo. A terra pertence {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, e tudo o que nela existe, o mundo e todos os que vivem nele.
pt.R: De Davi. Uma canção. A terra e tudo o que há nela pertencem {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}. O mundo e todas as pessoas que vivem nele são {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}.

am.L: የዳዊት። መዝሙር። ምድርና ሞላዋ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} [ናቸው]፤ ዓለምና በእርሷ የሚኖሩም።
am.B: የዳዊት። መዝሙር። ምድርና በእርሷ ያለው ሁሉ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ነው፤ ዓለምና በእርሷ የሚኖሩ ሁሉ።
am.R: ዳዊት የዘመረው መዝሙር። ምድርና በእርሷ ያለው ሁሉ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ነው። ዓለምና በእርሷ የሚኖሩ ሰዎች ሁሉ የእርሱ ናቸው።

hi.L: दाऊद का। भजन। पृथ्वी {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की [है], और जो कुछ उसे भरता है, संसार और उसमें रहनेवाले।
hi.B: दाऊद का। भजन। पृथ्वी {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की है, और जो कुछ उसमें भरा है, वह भी; संसार और उसमें रहनेवाले सब लोग भी।
hi.R: दाऊद का लिखा हुआ। एक गीत। पृथ्वी और उसमें की हर चीज़ {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की है। संसार और उसमें रहनेवाले सब लोग उन्हीं के हैं।

ru.L: Давида. Псалом. {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}} [принадлежит] земля и то, что наполняет её, мир и живущие в нём.
ru.B: Давида. Псалом. Земля принадлежит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}, и всё, что наполняет её, мир и все, кто живёт в нём.
ru.R: Песнь Давида. Земля и всё, что на ней, принадлежит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}. Мир и все люди, которые живут в нём, принадлежат {{deity_pronoun:ему|Ему}}.

ja.L: ダビデによる。賛歌。地とそれに満ちているものは{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}のもの、世界とそこに住む者たち[も]。
ja.B: ダビデによる。賛歌。地と、そこに満ちているものはすべて、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}のもの、世界も、そこに住むすべての者も。
ja.R: ダビデによる。歌。地は{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}のもの。そこにあるすべてのものも、そうだ。世界も、そこに住むすべての人々も、その方のものだ。

uk.L: Давидів. Псалом. {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}} [належить] земля і те, що її сповнює, світ і ті, хто живе в ньому.
uk.B: Давидів. Псалом. Земля належить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}}, і все, що її наповнює, світ і всі, хто в ньому живе.
uk.R: Давидова пісня. Земля належить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}}, і все, що на ній, теж. Світ і всі люди, які живуть у ньому, належать {{deity_pronoun:йому|Йому}}.

decisions.choice: The title shares verse 1
decisions.reason: This psalm's title is short and the Hebrew counts it together with the first line as verse 1, so here the verse numbers are the same as in Bibles that print the title without a number.

decisions.choice: quoted in 1 Corinthians 10:26
decisions.reason: Paul quotes this line to show that any food sold in the market may be eaten, since everything belongs to the Lord (1 Corinthians 10:26).

decisions.choice: its fullness: everything that fills it
decisions.reason: The word (melo') means what fills something: all that is in the earth.

decisions.choice: By David. A song.
decisions.reason: As in 11:1 and 3:1.

decisions.choice: "Of David. A psalm." is "다윗의 시."
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has two short words in the reverse of the usual order; Korean joins them into the usual title, which says the same thing. The psalm is in the plain written style, since it speaks about God, not to him.

decisions.choice: do SENHOR [é] a terra e a sua plenitude (L); A terra pertence ao SENHOR, e tudo o que nela existe (B); A terra e tudo o que há nela pertencem ao SENHOR (R)
decisions.reason: Paul quotes this line in 1 Corinthians 10:26 (m2). Each level uses the words of the Portuguese of 1 Corinthians 10:26 at the same level, with the LORD's name where Paul's Portuguese has "o Senhor".

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in the Amharic of Psalm 24.
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the setting that capitalises pronouns for God has nothing to change in Amharic; pronouns and verb forms for God are written plainly.

decisions.choice: "ምድርና ሞላዋ" (L) and "ምድርና በእርሷ ያለው ሁሉ" (B, R), as 1 Corinthians 10:26 in the Amharic New Testament, with the divine name where Paul has "the Lord" ("የጌታ")
decisions.reason: Paul quotes the verse, and the Greek agrees with the Hebrew; the Hebrew has the divine name, which the psalm keeps under its setting.

decisions.choice: as 1 Corinthians 10:26
decisions.reason: Paul quotes this line in 1 Corinthians 10:26 (m2), and the Hebrew says the same, so each level keeps the Hindi of that verse ("पृथ्वी प्रभु की है, और जो कुछ उसमें भरा है"), with the divine name where the psalm has it.

decisions.choice: "земля и то, что наполняет её" (L); "земля принадлежит ... и всё, что наполняет её" (B); "Земля и всё, что на ней, принадлежит" (R)
decisions.reason: 1 Corinthians 10:26 quotes this line (m2), and the Hebrew says the same, so each level keeps the Russian wording of that verse in this translation, with ГОСПОДЬ for the divine name where Paul has "Господь".

decisions.choice: "Песнь Давида"
decisions.reason: Readable puts the title in the order Russian expects; Literal and Balanced keep the Hebrew order "Давида. Псалом".

decisions.choice: "地とそれに満ちているものは…のもの" (L), "地と、そこに満ちているものはすべて、…のもの" (B), close to the Japanese of 1 Corinthians 10:26
decisions.reason: Paul quotes this line (m2) and the Hebrew agrees with his Greek, so Literal and Balanced follow the Japanese of 1 Corinthians 10:26; Readable says it in short sentences, as the English Readable.

decisions.choice: Title ledavid mizmor "ダビデによる。賛歌。" (L, B), "ダビデによる。歌。" (R), in the Hebrew order, at the head of the verse it shares
decisions.reason: As the Psalter's titles: 'Of David' alone is ダビデによる, mizmor 賛歌 (R 歌); the two pieces are separated by 。 as the English separates them.

records.literal_gloss: For he on [the] seas founded it, and on [the] rivers he established it.

en.L: For {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} on [the] seas founded it, and on [the] rivers {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} set it firm.
en.B: For it was {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} who laid its foundations on the seas and set it firmly on the rivers.
en.R: He is the one who built the earth on top of the seas. He made it stand firm above the rivers deep below.

fr.L: Car {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, sur [les] mers {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} l’a fondée, et sur [les] fleuves {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} l’a affermie.
fr.B: Car c’est {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} qui a posé ses fondations sur les mers et l’a établie solidement sur les fleuves.
fr.R: C’est {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} qui a bâti la terre au-dessus des mers. Il l’a rendue solide au-dessus des fleuves tout au fond.

sw.L: Kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} juu ya bahari aliiweka misingi yake, na juu ya mito aliithibitisha.
sw.B: Kwa maana ni {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} aliyeweka misingi yake juu ya bahari na kuiimarisha juu ya mito.
sw.R: Yeye ndiye aliyeijenga dunia juu ya bahari. Aliifanya isimame imara juu ya mito iliyo chini kabisa.

es.L: Porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} la cimentó sobre [los] mares, y sobre [las] corrientes la estableció.
es.B: Porque fue {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} quien puso sus cimientos sobre los mares y la asentó con firmeza sobre los ríos.
es.R: Él es quien construyó la tierra encima de los mares. La hizo estar firme sobre los ríos profundos de abajo.

vi.L: Vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã lập nền nó trên các biển, và trên các sông {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm cho nó vững chắc.
vi.B: Vì chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã đặt nền móng đất trên các biển và lập nó vững vàng trên các dòng sông.
vi.R: Chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã dựng nên trái đất trên mặt các biển. Ngài làm cho nó đứng vững trên những dòng sông sâu bên dưới.

ko.L: 참으로 그분께서 바다들 위에 그것을 세우셨고, 강들 위에 그것을 굳게 두셨다.
ko.B: 땅의 기초를 바다 위에 놓으시고 강들 위에 굳게 세우신 분이 바로 그분이시다.
ko.R: 그분께서 바다 위에 땅을 지으셨다. 깊은 곳의 강물 위에 땅을 든든히 세우셨다.

pt.L: Pois {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} sobre [os] mares a fundou, e sobre [os] rios {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} a firmou.
pt.B: Pois foi {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} quem lançou os alicerces dela sobre os mares e a firmou sobre os rios.
pt.R: Foi {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} quem construiu a terra por cima dos mares. Ele a fez ficar firme sobre os rios lá no fundo.

am.L: እርሱ በባሕሮች ላይ መሥርቷታልና፤ በወንዞችም ላይ አጽንቷታል።
am.B: መሠረቷን በባሕሮች ላይ የጣለ፣ በወንዞችም ላይ አጽንቶ ያቆማት እርሱ ነውና።
am.R: ምድርን በባሕሮች ላይ የሠራ እርሱ ነው። ከታች ባሉት ጥልቅ ወንዞች ላይ ጸንታ እንድትቆም አደረጋት።

hi.L: क्योंकि उन्होंने ही समुद्रों पर उसकी नींव डाली, और नदियों पर उसे स्थिर किया।
hi.B: क्योंकि उन्होंने ही समुद्रों पर उसकी नींव रखी और नदियों पर उसे दृढ़ता से टिकाया।
hi.R: उन्होंने ही समुद्रों के ऊपर पृथ्वी को बनाया। उन्होंने उसे नीचे की गहरी नदियों के ऊपर मज़बूती से खड़ा किया।

ru.L: Ведь {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} на морях основал её и на реках {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} утвердил её.
ru.B: Ведь это {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} положил её основание на морях и прочно поставил её на реках.
ru.R: Он — тот, кто построил землю поверх морей. Он сделал так, что она твёрдо стоит над реками глубоко внизу.

ja.L: まことに、その方が、海の上にそれの基を据え、川の上にそれを堅く立てられた。
ja.B: 海の上に地の基を据え、川の上にしっかりと立てられたのは、その方だからだ。
ja.R: その方が、海の上に地を造られた。地の下の深いところを流れる川の上に、地をしっかりと立てられた。

uk.L: Бо {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} на морях заснував її, і на ріках {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} її утвердив.
uk.B: Бо це {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} поклав її основи на морях і міцно поставив її на ріках.
uk.R: Він — той, хто збудував землю над морями. Він міцно поставив її над глибокими ріками внизу.

decisions.choice: on the seas, on the rivers: the earth set over the waters
decisions.reason: The earth is pictured as built over the deep waters, which God gathered and set in their place (Genesis 1:9-10; 136:6). The rivers (neharot) are the currents of the deep (93:3). The one who made it owns it (verse 1).

decisions.choice: for he: he himself
decisions.reason: The pronoun is stressed: it was he and no other who founded the earth.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans
decisions.reason: Devanagari has no capital letters, so the setting the English offers has nothing to change in Hindi. Respect for God comes from the honorific plural (वे, उन्होंने) and from the devotional तू when the psalmist speaks to him.

decisions.choice: ki-hu' "まことに、その方が" (L), "…のは、その方だからだ" (B), "その方が" (R); God as その方, never 彼
decisions.reason: The pronoun is emphatic, he himself (m2), so Balanced puts it in focus; the earth rests above the waters (m1), which Readable explains as the English Readable does.

records.literal_gloss: Who will go up on [the] mountain of YHWH, and who will stand in [the] place of his holiness?

en.L: Who will go up into the mountain of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and who will stand in the place of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} holiness?
en.B: Who has the right to climb the mountain of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}? Who may stand in the place of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} holiness?
en.R: Who is allowed to go up the hill where {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s temple is? Who may stand in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} holy place to worship {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}?

fr.L: Qui montera sur la montagne {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, et qui se tiendra dans le lieu de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} sainteté ?
fr.B: Qui a le droit de gravir la montagne {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ? Qui peut se tenir dans le lieu de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} sainteté ?
fr.R: Qui a la permission de monter sur la colline où se trouve le temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ? Qui peut se tenir dans {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} lieu saint pour {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}adorer ?

sw.L: Nani atapanda juu ya mlima wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, na nani atasimama mahali pa utakatifu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}?
sw.B: Ni nani mwenye haki ya kuupanda mlima wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}? Ni nani anayeweza kusimama mahali pa utakatifu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}?
sw.R: Ni nani anayeruhusiwa kupanda kilima kilipo hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}? Ni nani anayeweza kusimama mahali {{deity_pronoun:pake|Pake}} patakatifu ili kumwabudu?

es.L: ¿Quién subirá al monte {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y quién estará en el lugar de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} santidad?
es.B: ¿Quién tiene derecho a subir al monte {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}? ¿Quién puede estar de pie en el lugar de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} santidad?
es.R: ¿Quién puede subir a la colina donde está el templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}? ¿Quién puede estar en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} lugar santo para adorarlo?

vi.L: Ai sẽ lên núi của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và ai sẽ đứng trong nơi của sự thánh khiết của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}?
vi.B: Ai có quyền lên núi của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}? Ai được đứng trong nơi thánh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}?
vi.R: Ai được phép lên ngọn đồi có đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}? Ai được đứng trong nơi thánh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} để thờ phượng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}?

ko.L: 누가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 산에 오르며, 누가 그분의 거룩함의 처소에 설 것인가?
ko.B: 누가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 산에 오를 수 있는가? 누가 그분의 거룩한 곳에 설 수 있는가?
ko.R: 누가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전이 있는 언덕에 올라갈 수 있는가? 누가 그분의 거룩한 곳에 서서 그분께 예배할 수 있는가?

pt.L: Quem subirá ao monte {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, e quem ficará de pé no lugar da {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} santidade?
pt.B: Quem tem o direito de subir o monte {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}? Quem pode estar de pé no lugar da {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} santidade?
pt.R: Quem tem permissão para subir o monte onde fica o templo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}? Quem pode entrar no {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} lugar santo para adorá-{{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}}?

am.L: ወደ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ተራራ ማን ይወጣል? በቅድስናውስ ስፍራ ማን ይቆማል?
am.B: ወደ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ተራራ ለመውጣት መብት ያለው ማን ነው? በቅድስናው ስፍራስ ማን ሊቆም ይችላል?
am.R: {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ቤተ መቅደስ ወዳለበት ኮረብታ እንዲወጣ የተፈቀደለት ማን ነው? እርሱን ለማምለክ በቅዱስ ስፍራው ማን ሊቆም ይችላል?

hi.L: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के पर्वत पर कौन चढ़ेगा, और उनकी पवित्रता के स्थान में कौन खड़ा होगा?
hi.B: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के पर्वत पर चढ़ने का अधिकार किसे है? उनकी पवित्रता के स्थान में कौन खड़ा हो सकता है?
hi.R: उस पहाड़ी पर कौन जा सकता है जहाँ {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का मंदिर है? उनके पवित्र स्थान में खड़े होकर उनकी आराधना कौन कर सकता है?

ru.L: Кто взойдёт на гору {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, и кто встанет на месте {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} святости?
ru.B: Кто имеет право подняться на гору {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}? Кто может стоять на месте {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} святости?
ru.R: Кому позволено подняться на холм, где стоит храм {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}? Кто может стоять в {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} святом месте, чтобы поклоняться {{deity_pronoun:ему|Ему}}?

ja.L: だれが{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の山に登るのか？だれがその方の聖なる場所に立つのか？
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の山に登ることができるのは、だれか？その方の聖なる場所に立つことが許されるのは、だれか？
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の神殿がある丘に登ってよいのは、だれか？その方の聖なる場所に立って、その方を礼拝してよいのは、だれか？

uk.L: Хто зійде на гору {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, і хто стане на місці {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} святості?
uk.B: Хто має право зійти на гору {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}? Хто може стати на місці {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} святості?
uk.R: Кому дозволено піднятися на пагорб, де стоїть храм {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}? Хто може стати в {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} святому місці, щоб поклонитися {{deity_pronoun:йому|Йому}}?

decisions.choice: the mountain of the LORD: Zion, where the temple stood
decisions.reason: Worshipers went up to the hill of Zion in Jerusalem. The question and answer, as in 15:1-5, may have been spoken at the gate as worshipers arrived.

decisions.choice: who will go up: who may go up
decisions.reason: The verbs ask who is fit and allowed to come into God's presence.

decisions.choice: where the LORD's temple is; to worship him
decisions.reason: Readable says what the mountain and the standing are about (m1).

decisions.choice: "登ることができるのは" / "立つことが許されるのは" (B), "登ってよいのは" / "立って…礼拝してよいのは" (R)
decisions.reason: The question asks who may go up (m2), as the English Balanced and Readable say; Readable supplies the temple and worship as the English Readable does (r-en-1).

source.text: נְקִ֥י כַפַּ֗יִם וּֽבַר־לֵ֫בָ֥ב אֲשֶׁ֤ר׀לֹא־נָשָׂ֣א לַשָּׁ֣וְא נַפְשִׁ֑י וְלֹ֖א נִשְׁבַּ֣ע לְמִרְמָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: [The] clean of hands and pure of heart, who has not lifted up to falsehood my soul, and has not sworn to deceit.

en.L: [One] clean of hands and pure of heart, who has not lifted up {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} soul to falsehood, and has not sworn deceitfully.
en.B: Those whose hands are innocent and whose hearts are pure, who have not called on God's own life to back what is false, and have not sworn an oath to deceive.
en.R: It is people who do what is right and whose thoughts are pure. They do not use God's name to make a lie seem true. They do not make promises to trick others.

fr.L: [Celui qui a] les mains innocentes et le cœur pur, qui n’a pas élevé {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} âme vers le mensonge, et qui n’a pas juré pour tromper.
fr.B: Ceux dont les mains sont innocentes et le cœur pur, qui n’ont pas pris à témoin la vie même de Dieu pour appuyer le mensonge, et n’ont pas prêté serment pour tromper.
fr.R: Ce sont les gens qui font ce qui est juste et dont les pensées sont pures. Ils ne se servent pas du nom de Dieu pour faire passer un mensonge pour la vérité. Ils ne font pas de promesses pour tromper les autres.

sw.L: [Mtu] mwenye mikono safi na moyo mweupe, asiyeiinua nafsi {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} kwa ubatili, wala hakuapa kwa hila.
sw.B: Wale ambao mikono yao haina hatia na mioyo yao ni safi, wasioutaja uhai wa Mungu mwenyewe kuthibitisha uongo, wala hawakuapa kiapo ili kudanganya.
sw.R: Ni watu wanaotenda yaliyo haki na ambao mawazo yao ni safi. Hawalitumii jina la Mungu ili kufanya uongo uonekane kweli. Hawatoi ahadi ili kuwadanganya wengine.

es.L: [El] limpio de manos y puro de corazón, que no ha elevado {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} alma a la falsedad, y no ha jurado con engaño.
es.B: Los que tienen manos inocentes y corazón puro, que no han invocado la vida misma de Dios para respaldar lo falso, ni han hecho un juramento para engañar.
es.R: Son las personas que hacen lo correcto y cuyos pensamientos son puros. No usan el nombre de Dios para que una mentira parezca verdad. No hacen promesas para engañar a otros.

vi.L: [Người] có tay sạch và lòng trong sạch, là người không hướng linh hồn {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} về điều giả dối, và không thề cách gian trá.
vi.B: Đó là những người có tay vô tội và lòng trong sạch, không viện đến chính sự sống của Đức Chúa Trời để bênh vực điều dối trá, và không thề thốt để lừa gạt.
vi.R: Đó là những người làm điều đúng và có tâm trí trong sạch. Họ không dùng danh Đức Chúa Trời để làm cho lời dối trá có vẻ thật. Họ không hứa hẹn để lừa gạt người khác.

ko.L: 손이 깨끗하고 마음이 순결하며, 내 영혼을 헛된 것에 들어 올리지 않고, 속이려고 맹세하지 않은 [사람이다].
ko.B: 손이 깨끗하고 마음이 순결한 사람, 하나님의 생명을 걸고 거짓을 내세우지 않으며 속이려고 맹세하지 않는 사람이다.
ko.R: 옳은 일을 하고 생각이 깨끗한 사람들이다. 그들은 하나님의 이름을 써서 거짓말을 참말처럼 꾸미지 않는다. 남을 속이려고 약속하지도 않는다.

pt.L: [Aquele que é] limpo de mãos e puro de coração, que não elevou a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} alma à falsidade e não jurou com engano.
pt.B: Aqueles que têm as mãos inocentes e o coração puro, que não invocaram a própria vida de Deus para apoiar o que é falso, nem fizeram juramento para enganar.
pt.R: São as pessoas que fazem o que é certo e cujos pensamentos são puros. Elas não usam o nome de Deus para fazer uma mentira parecer verdade. Elas não fazem promessas para enganar os outros.

am.L: እጆቹ ንጹሕ፣ ልቡም የጠራ፣ ነፍሴን ወደ ሐሰት ያላነሣ፣ ለማታለልም ያልማለ [ነው]።
am.B: እጆቻቸው ከበደል ንጹሕ፣ ልባቸውም የጠራ፣ ሐሰትን ለማጽናት በእግዚአብሔር ሕይወት ያልማሉ፣ ለማታለልም መሐላ ያልገቡ ናቸው።
am.R: ትክክል የሆነውን የሚያደርጉና ሐሳባቸው ንጹሕ የሆነ ሰዎች ናቸው። ውሸትን እውነት ለማስመሰል የእግዚአብሔርን ስም አይጠሩም። ሌሎችን ለማታለል ቃል አይገቡም።

hi.L: हाथों का निर्दोष और हृदय का शुद्ध [व्यक्ति], जिसने मेरे प्राण को झूठ की ओर नहीं उठाया, और धोखे के लिए शपथ नहीं ली।
hi.B: वे लोग जिनके हाथ निर्दोष और मन पवित्र हैं, जिन्होंने किसी झूठी बात को सहारा देने के लिए परमेश्वर के जीवन की दुहाई नहीं दी, और धोखा देने के लिए शपथ नहीं ली।
hi.R: वे लोग, जो सही काम करते हैं और जिनके विचार शुद्ध हैं। वे परमेश्वर का नाम लेकर किसी झूठ को सच जैसा नहीं दिखाते। वे दूसरों को ठगने के लिए वादे नहीं करते।

ru.L: [Тот, кто] чист руками и непорочен сердцем, кто не возносил {{deity_pronoun:мою|Мою}} душу к лжи и не клялся обманно.
ru.B: Те, чьи руки невинны и чьи сердца чисты, кто не призывал саму жизнь Бога в подтверждение лжи и не клялся, чтобы обмануть.
ru.R: Это люди, которые поступают правильно и у которых чистые мысли. Они не используют имя Бога, чтобы ложь казалась правдой. Они не дают обещаний, чтобы обмануть других.

ja.L: 手が清く、心の純粋な[者]、わたしの魂を偽りに向けて上げたことがなく、欺いて誓ったことのない[者]。
ja.B: それは、手に汚れがなく、心の清い人たち、神ご自身の命を持ち出して偽りを支えたことがなく、人を欺くために誓ったことのない人たちだ。
ja.R: それは、正しいことを行い、心の思いが清い人たちだ。その人たちは、うそを本当らしく見せるために、神の名を使ったりしない。人をだますために、約束したりもしない。

uk.L: [Той, хто] чистий руками й чистий серцем, хто не підносив {{deity_pronoun:моєї|Моєї}} душі до марноти і не присягав облудно.
uk.B: Ті, чиї руки невинні, а серця чисті, хто не кликав самого життя Божого на підтвердження неправди і не присягав, щоб обманути.
uk.R: Це люди, які чинять правильно й мають чисті думки. Вони не вживають Божого імені, щоб брехня здавалася правдою. Вони не дають обіцянок, щоб ошукати інших.

decisions.choice: clean hands and pure heart: right in deed and in thought
decisions.reason: The hands stand for what a person does, the heart for what they think and want (73:1, 13).

decisions.choice: lifted up my soul: the LORD speaks of himself
alternatives: lifted up his soul to falsehood: set his desire on what is empty (many Hebrew manuscripts and the ancient Greek translation)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew text reads "my soul": the LORD's own self, by which an oath was sworn (Amos 6:8), so that the line forbids taking God in vain in a false oath (Exodus 20:7). Many Hebrew manuscripts and the ancient Greek translation read "his soul", and to lift up one's soul is to long for something (25:1): then the line means someone who has not set his heart on what is empty, such as idols. The Hebrew text is followed.

decisions.choice: falsehood: what is empty and false
decisions.reason: The word (shav') means emptiness, falsehood; it is used of idols (31:7) and of false oaths.

decisions.choice: God's own life (B); God's name (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say whose soul is meant (m2) and what lifting it to falsehood means.

decisions.choice: those ... they
decisions.reason: The Hebrew describes one person who stands for all who live this way; Balanced and Readable make it plural.

decisions.choice: "linh hồn Ta" (my soul), the LORD speaking of himself, at Literal
decisions.reason: The Hebrew, as handed down, has the LORD say "my soul" here (see the meaning decision), so Literal keeps God's "Ta" with the setting; Balanced and Readable explain it as swearing falsely by God's own life, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "내 영혼" (my soul) kept at Literal, where "my" is the LORD's
decisions.reason: In the Hebrew text as read the LORD speaks of himself here (meaning decision m2); Literal keeps the word as it stands, as the English does with "My", and Balanced and Readable say whose life is meant. Korean cannot mark the pronoun as God's with a capital, so a reader of Literal needs this note.

decisions.choice: "ነፍሴን" (my soul) kept at Literal
decisions.reason: As meaning decision m2, the text as written has the LORD speak of his own life, sworn by falsely; Balanced and Readable say whose life it is, as the English.

decisions.choice: मेरे प्राण
decisions.reason: The Hebrew as written has "my soul": the LORD speaks of his own life, by which people swore (m2). Literal keeps "my" (मेरे), God's own word, which Hindi cannot mark with a capital as the English does; Balanced and Readable say whose life is meant, as the English does.

decisions.choice: nafshi "わたしの魂" (L), "神ご自身の命" (B), "神の名" (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew text has "my soul", the LORD speaking of himself (m2, uncertain, footnoted): Literal keeps it, Balanced and Readable say what it means, as the English (r-en-1); the people are 人たち with no gender span (r-en-2).

source.text: יִשָּׂ֣א בְ֭רָכָה מֵאֵ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה וּ֝צְדָקָ֗ה מֵאֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׁעֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: He will lift up blessing from with YHWH, and righteousness from [the] God of his salvation.

en.L: {{gender:Such a one|He}} will receive blessing from {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and righteousness from the God of {{gender:their|his}} salvation.
en.B: Such people carry away a blessing from {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and justice from the God who saves them.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will bless them. God, who saves them, will treat them as people who are right with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.

fr.L: Celui-là recevra la bénédiction {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, et la justice du Dieu de son salut.
fr.B: De tels gens emportent une bénédiction {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, et la justice du Dieu qui les sauve.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} les bénira. Dieu, qui les sauve, les traitera comme des gens qui sont en règle avec {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.

sw.L: Huyo atapokea baraka kutoka kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, na haki kutoka kwa Mungu wa wokovu wake.
sw.B: Watu kama hao wanapata baraka kutoka kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, na haki kutoka kwa Mungu anayewaokoa.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atawabariki. Mungu, anayewaokoa, atawahesabu kuwa watu walio wenye haki mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.

es.L: {{gender:Esa persona|Él}} recibirá bendición {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y justicia del Dios de su salvación.
es.B: Esas personas reciben bendición {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y justicia del Dios que las salva.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} los bendecirá. Dios, que los salva, los tratará como personas que están bien con {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.

vi.L: Người ấy sẽ nhận phước lành từ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và sự công chính từ Đức Chúa Trời của sự cứu rỗi mình.
vi.B: Những người như thế sẽ mang lấy phước lành từ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và sự công chính từ Đức Chúa Trời, Đấng cứu rỗi họ.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ ban phước cho họ. Đức Chúa Trời, Đấng cứu họ, sẽ đối xử với họ như những người ngay thẳng trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 그런 사람은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께로부터 복을 받고, 그의 구원의 하나님께로부터 의를 받을 것이다.
ko.B: 그런 사람들은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 복을 받고, 그들을 구원하시는 하나님께 의로움을 인정받는다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그들에게 복을 주실 것이다. 그들을 구원하시는 하나님께서 그들을 그분 앞에 옳은 사람으로 대하실 것이다.

pt.L: {{gender:Essa pessoa|Ele}} receberá bênção {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, e justiça do Deus da sua salvação.

pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} vai abençoá-las. Deus, que as salva, vai tratá-las como pessoas que estão em paz com {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}.

am.L: እንዲህ ያለው ሰው {{divine_name:ከእግዚአብሔር|ከያህዌ}} ዘንድ በረከትን ይቀበላል፤ ከመዳኑ አምላክም ጽድቅን [ይቀበላል]።
am.B: እንዲህ ያሉ ሰዎች {{divine_name:ከእግዚአብሔር|ከያህዌ}} ዘንድ በረከትን፣ ከሚያድናቸውም አምላክ ጽድቅን ይቀበላሉ።

hi.B: ऐसे लोग {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} से आशीष लेकर जाते हैं, और अपने उद्धार करनेवाले परमेश्वर से न्याय पाते हैं।

ru.L: Такой человек получит благословение от {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} и праведность от Бога своего спасения.
ru.B: Такие люди получают благословение от {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} и оправдание от Бога, который их спасает.
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} благословит их. Бог, который их спасает, будет считать их праведными перед {{deity_pronoun:ним|Ним}}.

ja.L: その人は{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}から祝福を受け、その救いの神から義を[受ける]。
ja.B: そのような人たちは、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}から祝福を携えて帰り、自分を救ってくださる神から義を与えられる。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、その人たちを祝福してくださる。その人たちを救ってくださる神は、その人たちを、ご自分の前で正しい者として扱ってくださる。

uk.L: {{gender:Така людина|Він}} прийме благословення від {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} і праведність від Бога свого спасіння.
uk.B: Такі люди отримають благословення від {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} і справедливість від Бога, який їх спасає.

decisions.choice: lift up blessing: receive and carry away a blessing
decisions.reason: The same verb as "lifted up" in verse 4: one who has not lifted his soul to falsehood will lift up a blessing.

decisions.choice: righteousness: vindication, right standing
decisions.reason: Beside blessing, righteousness (tsedaqah) is a gift: God declares and treats such a person as in the right.

decisions.choice: such a one / their, with "he" / "his" as the alternative
decisions.reason: The person of verse 4 stands for anyone who lives this way.

decisions.choice: "Người ấy", "mình" with no gender span
alternatives: gender spans as in the English
decisions.reason: As in Psalms 1 and 15, "người ấy" and "mình" already fit a man or a woman.

decisions.choice: Essa pessoa, with "Ele" as the alternative; "sua" with no setting
decisions.reason: As the English, the subject is under the gender setting. The English needs a second span for "their/his salvation"; Portuguese "sua" agrees with "salvação" and says nothing about the person's sex, so it needs none.

decisions.choice: "እንዲህ ያለው ሰው" (such a person) and "መዳኑ" with no gender span
alternatives: a gender span, as the English Literal
decisions.reason: "ሰው" and the generic masculine suffix already include women and men, so Amharic has one wording here (docs/amharic-style.md 7b).

decisions.choice: ऐसा व्यक्ति, no gender span
decisions.reason: The English Literal offers "such a one / their" with "he / his" as the alternative. Hindi ऐसा व्यक्ति and the reflexive अपने already speak of anyone, so the Hindi has no span.

decisions.choice: "Такой человек ... своего", no gender span
decisions.reason: "Человек" covers a man or a woman, and the reflexive "своего" has no gender, so Russian needs no span where the English has one for "such a one / he" and "their / his".

decisions.choice: "その人" with no gender span, where the English Literal has {{gender:Such a one|He}} and {{gender:their|his}}
decisions.reason: Japanese その人 already includes men and women (style guide section 7a), so no span is needed; the same holds for the rest of Psalms 23-33.

decisions.choice: tsedaqah "義" (L, B), "ご自分の前で正しい者として扱ってくださる" (R)
decisions.reason: Righteousness here is vindication, right standing given by God (m2); 義 stays the key word at Literal and Balanced, Readable says it by sense as the English Readable.

records.literal_gloss: This [is the] generation of those who seek him, those who seek your face, Jacob. Selah.

en.L: This [is the] generation of those who seek {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, who seek {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} face, [this is] Jacob. Selah
en.B: Such are the people who look for {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, who seek {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} face: this is Jacob. Selah
en.R: These are the kind of people who look to God and long to see {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} face. They are the true family of Jacob. Selah

fr.L: Telle [est] la génération de ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} cherchent, qui cherchent {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} face, [c’est] Jacob. Sélah
fr.B: Tels sont ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} recherchent, qui cherchent {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} face : voilà Jacob. Sélah
fr.R: Voilà les gens qui se tournent vers Dieu et qui désirent voir {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} visage. Ils sont la vraie famille de Jacob. Sélah

sw.B: Ndivyo walivyo watu wanaomtafuta, wanaoutafuta uso {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}: huyu ndiye Yakobo. Sela
sw.R: Hawa ndio aina ya watu wanaomtazamia Mungu na kutamani kuuona uso {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}. Wao ndio jamaa halisi ya Yakobo. Sela

ru.L: Таково поколение ищущих {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}, ищущих {{deity_pronoun:твоего|Твоего}} лица, [это] Иаков. Села

decisions.choice: those who seek him: the word as read, not as written
decisions.reason: The Hebrew text writes this word in a form that may be read as "one who seeks him", and its notes say to read the plural. The meaning is the same. The words follow the form to be read.

decisions.choice: your face, Jacob: those who seek God are the true Jacob
alternatives: who seek your face, God of Jacob (the ancient Greek translation)
decisions.reason: As the Hebrew stands, the line turns to speak to God ("your face") and names those who seek him "Jacob", the true people of God. The ancient Greek translation has "who seek the face of the God of Jacob".

decisions.choice: generation: a kind of people
decisions.reason: The word (dor) can mean a group of people of the same kind (14:5).

decisions.choice: his face
decisions.reason: Readable keeps speaking about God, rather than turning to address him (m2).

decisions.choice: Selah: a word whose meaning is no longer known
alternatives: lift up (the voice or the music)
decisions.reason: Selah stands at the end of a line 71 times in the Psalms and 3 times in Habakkuk 3. It is probably a direction for singing or music, perhaps a pause or an interlude; the ancient Greek translation renders it with a word meaning "interlude". It is not part of what is said, and here it marks a break after the line.

decisions.choice: Selah, kept as it is
decisions.reason: Its meaning is unknown (see the meaning decision on Selah), so every level keeps the word rather than guess, and keeps it apart from the sentence.

decisions.choice: "주님의 얼굴" (your face) for the brief turn to God, with no change of speech level
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "your face" in the middle of a description; Korean names God by the title of address, "주님", which shows the turn without making the verse a prayer.

decisions.choice: Selah as "ሴላ", at the end of its line at every level
decisions.reason: As the terms list sets for the Psalms: the meaning of the word is no longer known (meaning decision m3), so it is kept as a name, as the English keeps "Selah".

decisions.choice: सेला
decisions.reason: Selah is a word whose meaning is no longer known, probably a musical direction. Every level keeps it, as सेला, at the end of the verse as the English does.

decisions.choice: तेरे मुख
decisions.reason: The line turns to speak to God ("your face"), so Literal and Balanced say तेरे, the devotional address; Readable keeps speaking about him (उनका), as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "Села", at the end of the verse
decisions.reason: A word whose meaning is unknown, probably a musical direction (m4); every level keeps it where the English does, in the form the poetry terms note gives. Recorded once for Psalms 23-33.

decisions.choice: dor "世代" (L), "このような人たち" (B, R); "[これが]ヤコブ[である]" (L), "これがヤコブだ" (B), "本当のヤコブの家族" (R)
decisions.reason: The generation is a kind of people (m3), and those who seek God are the true Jacob (m2, uncertain, footnoted), as the English reads it.

decisions.choice: Selah "セラ" at every level, straight after the closing 。, as the Psalter's convention
decisions.reason: Its meaning is no longer known (m4); it is kept as it is at the end of the verse's last line, as from Psalm 3.

source.text: שְׂא֤וּ שְׁעָרִ֨ים׀רָֽאשֵׁיכֶ֗ם וְֽ֭הִנָּשְׂאוּ פִּתְחֵ֣י עוֹלָ֑ם וְ֝יָב֗וֹא מֶ֣לֶךְ הַכָּבֽוֹד׃

records.literal_gloss: Lift up, gates, your heads, and be lifted up, doors of antiquity, that may come in [the] King of glory.

en.L: Lift up, gates, your heads, and be lifted up, ancient doors, that the King of glory may come in!
en.B: Gates, raise your heads high! Lift yourselves up, age-old doors, so that the King of glory may enter.
en.R: Open wide, you city gates! Make way, you very old doors! The glorious King is coming in!

fr.L: Portes, élevez vos têtes, et élevez-vous, portails antiques, pour que le Roi de gloire entre !
fr.B: Portes, levez bien haut la tête ! Dressez-vous, portails des temps anciens, pour que le Roi de gloire puisse entrer.
fr.R: Ouvrez-vous tout grand, portes de la ville ! Faites place, vieilles portes ! Le Roi glorieux arrive !

sw.L: Inueni, enyi malango, vichwa vyenu, na mwinuliwe, enyi milango ya kale, ili Mfalme wa utukufu aingie!
sw.B: Enyi malango, inueni vichwa vyenu juu! Jiinueni, enyi milango ya tangu zamani, ili Mfalme wa utukufu aingie.
sw.R: Fungukeni wazi, enyi malango ya mji! Toeni nafasi, enyi milango ya zamani sana! Mfalme mtukufu anaingia!

es.L: {{plural_you:Levanten|Levantad}}, puertas, {{plural_you:sus cabezas|vuestras cabezas}}, y {{plural_you:levántense|levantaos}}, portones antiguos, ¡para que entre el Rey de la gloria!
es.B: ¡Puertas, {{plural_you:levanten bien alto sus cabezas|levantad bien alto vuestras cabezas}}! {{plural_you:Álcense|Alzaos}}, portones de siglos, para que entre el Rey de la gloria.
es.R: ¡{{plural_you:Ábranse|Abríos}} de par en par, puertas de la ciudad! ¡{{plural_you:Dejen|Dejad}} paso, puertas tan antiguas! ¡El Rey glorioso va a entrar!

vi.L: Hỡi các cổng thành, hãy ngẩng đầu lên, và hỡi các cửa xưa cổ, hãy được nâng lên, để Vua vinh quang tiến vào!
vi.B: Hỡi các cổng thành, hãy ngẩng cao đầu! Hỡi các cửa ngàn xưa, hãy nâng mình lên, để Vua vinh quang bước vào.
vi.R: Hỡi các cổng thành, hãy mở rộng ra! Hỡi những cánh cửa thật xưa, hãy mở lối! Vị Vua vinh hiển đang tiến vào!

ko.L: 성문들아, 너희 머리를 들어라. 옛 문들아, 들려 올라가라. 영광의 왕께서 들어가시도록!
ko.B: 성문들아, 머리를 높이 들어라! 오래된 문들아, 활짝 일어서라! 영광의 왕께서 들어가실 것이다.
ko.R: 성문들아, 활짝 열려라! 아주 오래된 문들아, 길을 내어라! 영광스러운 왕께서 들어오신다!

pt.L: Levantem, portas, as suas cabeças, e levantem-se, entradas antigas, para que entre o Rei da glória!
pt.B: Portas, ergam bem alto as suas cabeças! Levantem-se, entradas de tempos antigos, para que o Rei da glória possa entrar.
pt.R: Abram-se de par em par, portões da cidade! Deem passagem, portas tão antigas! O Rei glorioso vai entrar!

am.L: እናንተ በሮች፣ ራሶቻችሁን አንሡ፤ እናንተ የጥንት መዝጊያዎች፣ ከፍ ከፍ በሉ፤ የክብር ንጉሥ ይገባ ዘንድ!
am.B: በሮች ሆይ፣ ራሶቻችሁን ቀና አድርጉ! የጥንት መዝጊያዎች ሆይ፣ ከፍ በሉ፤ የክብር ንጉሥ እንዲገባ።
am.R: እናንተ የከተማ በሮች፣ በሰፊው ተከፈቱ! እናንተ እጅግ ያረጃችሁ መዝጊያዎች፣ መንገድ ልቀቁ! ክቡሩ ንጉሥ እየገባ ነው!

hi.L: हे फाटको, अपने सिर उठाओ, और हे प्राचीन किवाड़ो, उठ जाओ, कि महिमा का राजा भीतर आएँ!
hi.B: हे फाटको, अपने सिर ऊँचे उठाओ! हे युगों पुराने किवाड़ो, ऊपर उठो, ताकि महिमा का राजा भीतर आ सकें।
hi.R: हे नगर के फाटको, पूरे खुल जाओ! हे बहुत पुराने किवाड़ो, रास्ता दो! महिमामय राजा भीतर आ रहे हैं!

ru.L: Поднимите, ворота, ваши головы, и поднимитесь, древние двери, чтобы вошёл Царь славы!
ru.B: Ворота, поднимите выше головы! Поднимитесь, вековые двери, чтобы вошёл Царь славы.
ru.R: Распахнитесь пошире, городские ворота! Дайте дорогу, очень древние двери! Входит славный Царь!

ja.L: 門よ、頭を上げよ！いにしえの扉よ、上がれ！栄光の王が入って来られるために。
ja.B: 門よ、頭を高く上げよ！古くからの扉よ、高く上がれ！栄光の王が入って来られるように。
ja.R: 町の門よ、大きく開け！とても古い扉よ、道をあけよ！栄光に輝く王が入って来られる！

uk.L: Підніміть, брами, ваші голови, і підніміться, вічні двері, щоб увійшов Цар слави!
uk.B: Брами, підніміть високо ваші голови! Підніміться, прадавні двері, щоб увійшов Цар слави.
uk.R: Відчиніться навстіж, міські брами! Розступіться, прадавні двері! Славний Цар входить!

decisions.choice: lift up your heads: rise high to let him in
decisions.reason: The gates are spoken to as if they were people. Their "heads" are the beams above them: they must rise up to make room for a King so great, and lift their heads in joy.

decisions.choice: the King of glory: the LORD entering his city
decisions.reason: The scene may recall the ark being brought up to Jerusalem (2 Samuel 6), with the LORD entering as King. "King" here is the LORD.

decisions.choice: doors of antiquity: ancient doors
decisions.reason: The word ('olam) means a time long past, or lasting; the doors are age-old.

decisions.choice: open wide; make way
decisions.reason: Readable says what lifting their heads means (m1).

decisions.choice: {{plural_you:levanten|levantad}}
decisions.reason: The gates and doors are spoken to as a group, so the commands are plural and take the plural_you setting, "ustedes" by default and "vosotros" as the alternative.

decisions.choice: "Vua vinh quang" (L, B); "vị Vua vinh hiển" (R)
decisions.reason: "Vua vinh quang" says "the King of glory" in Vietnamese order without the heavier "của"; the capital marks it as a title of the LORD (see the meaning decision).

decisions.choice: The gates are addressed in 해라체 ("성문들아 ... 들어라")
decisions.reason: A call to things, as in poetry, takes the plain imperative; the King of glory is spoken of with the honorific (께서).

decisions.choice: vocês (the gates addressed as a group)
decisions.reason: The gates are spoken to as if they were people (m1), so they are addressed as a group with "vocês" forms ("Levantem", "suas cabeças"), the only living second person plural in Brazil.

decisions.choice: "ራሶቻችሁን አንሡ" (lift up your heads); doors of antiquity "የጥንት መዝጊያዎች"
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep the picture of the gates raising their heads (meaning decision m1); Readable says "open wide", as the English Readable. Verse 9 repeats the call and reads alike.

decisions.choice: महिमा का राजा (L, B); महिमामय राजा (R), with honorific verbs
decisions.reason: The King of glory is the LORD entering his city (m2), so the verbs are honorific plural (आएँ, आ रहे हैं), as for God everywhere. Readable says "glorious King" (महिमामय राजा), as the English does.

decisions.choice: "ворота ... головы"
decisions.reason: Modern "ворота" and the plain "головы" keep the picture of gates lifting their heads (m1), without the Slavonic forms of the familiar version.

decisions.choice: Calls to the gates "〜よ、…上げよ！" (L, B), "開け！" / "道をあけよ！" (R); melekh hakkavod "栄光の王" (L, B), "栄光に輝く王" (R), with "入って来られる"
alternatives: おまえたちの頭を上げよ (L)
decisions.reason: The gates are addressed as the earth and creation are in the Psalter (〜よ, 〜せよ at every level), with no pronoun for "your heads"; the King of glory is the LORD entering his city (m2), so his coming takes the respect form.

source.text: מִ֥י זֶה֮ מֶ֤לֶךְ הַכָּ֫ב֥וֹד יְ֭הוָה עִזּ֣וּז וְגִבּ֑וֹר יְ֝הוָ֗ה גִּבּ֥וֹר מִלְחָמָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Who [is] this King of glory? YHWH strong and mighty, YHWH mighty [in] battle.

en.L: Who [is] this King of glory? {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} strong and mighty, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} mighty [in] battle.
en.B: Who is this King of glory? It is {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, mighty and strong, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, a warrior strong in battle.
en.R: Who is this glorious King? It is {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, who is strong and powerful. It is {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, who wins every battle.

fr.L: Qui [est] ce Roi de gloire ? {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} fort et puissant, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} puissant [au] combat.
fr.B: Qui est ce Roi de gloire ? C’est {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, puissant et fort, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, un guerrier redoutable au combat.
fr.R: Qui est ce Roi glorieux ? C’est {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, qui est fort et puissant. C’est {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, qui gagne toutes les batailles.

sw.L: Huyu Mfalme wa utukufu [ni] nani? {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} mwenye nguvu na hodari, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hodari [wa] vita.
sw.B: Ni nani huyu Mfalme wa utukufu? Ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, mwenye uweza na nguvu, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, shujaa mwenye nguvu vitani.
sw.R: Ni nani huyu Mfalme mtukufu? Ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, aliye na nguvu na uweza. Ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, anayeshinda kila vita.

es.L: ¿Quién [es] este Rey de la gloria? {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} fuerte y poderoso, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} poderoso [en] batalla.
es.B: ¿Quién es este Rey de la gloria? Es {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, poderoso y fuerte, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, guerrero fuerte en la batalla.
es.R: ¿Quién es este Rey glorioso? Es {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, que es fuerte y poderoso. Es {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, que gana todas las batallas.

vi.L: Vua vinh quang này [là] ai? {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} mạnh mẽ và quyền năng, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} quyền năng [trong] chiến trận.
vi.B: Vua vinh quang này là ai? Đó là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, đầy quyền năng và sức mạnh, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, chiến sĩ dũng mãnh nơi chiến trận.
vi.R: Vị Vua vinh hiển này là ai? Đó là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đấng mạnh mẽ và đầy quyền năng. Đó là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đấng thắng mọi trận chiến.

ko.L: 이 영광의 왕은 누구신가? 강하고 용맹하신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}, 싸움에 용맹하신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}이시다.
ko.B: 이 영광의 왕은 누구신가? 강하고 힘센 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}, 전쟁에 능하신 용사 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}이시다.
ko.R: 이 영광스러운 왕은 누구신가? 강하고 힘이 넘치시는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}이시다. 모든 싸움에서 이기시는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}이시다.

pt.L: Quem [é] este Rei da glória? {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}}, forte e poderoso, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, poderoso [na] batalha.
pt.B: Quem é este Rei da glória? É {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, forte e poderoso, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, um guerreiro poderoso na batalha.
pt.R: Quem é este Rei glorioso? É {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, que é forte e poderoso. É {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, que vence todas as batalhas.

am.L: ይህ የክብር ንጉሥ ማን [ነው]? ብርቱና ኃያል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}፣ በጦርነት ኃያል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}።
am.B: ይህ የክብር ንጉሥ ማን ነው? እርሱ ኃያልና ብርቱ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ነው፤ በጦርነት ብርቱ ተዋጊ የሆነው {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ነው።
am.R: ይህ ክቡር ንጉሥ ማን ነው? ብርቱና ኃያል የሆነው {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ነው። በጦርነት ሁሉ ድል የሚያደርገው {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ነው።

hi.L: यह महिमा का राजा कौन [है]? बलवान और पराक्रमी {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, युद्ध में पराक्रमी {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}।
hi.B: यह महिमा का राजा कौन है? वे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} हैं, पराक्रमी और बलवान; {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, जो युद्ध में बलवान योद्धा हैं।
hi.R: यह महिमामय राजा कौन है? ये {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} हैं, जो बलवान और सामर्थी हैं। ये {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} हैं, जो हर युद्ध जीतते हैं।

ru.L: Кто этот Царь славы? {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} сильный и могучий, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} могучий [в] битве.
ru.B: Кто этот Царь славы? Это {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, могучий и сильный, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, воин, сильный в бою.
ru.R: Кто этот славный Царь? Это {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, сильный и могущественный. Это {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, который побеждает в каждой битве.

ja.L: この栄光の王とは、だれか？強く、勇ましい{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}、戦いに勇ましい{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}。
ja.B: この栄光の王とは、だれか？それは{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}、力強く勇ましい方、戦いに強い勇士である{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}だ。
ja.R: この栄光に輝く王は、だれか？それは{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}、強くて力のある方。それは{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}、どんな戦いにも勝つ方だ。

uk.L: Хто цей Цар слави? {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} сильний і могутній, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} могутній [у] битві.
uk.B: Хто цей Цар слави? Це {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, могутній і сильний, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, воїн, сильний у битві.
uk.R: Хто цей славний Цар? Це {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, сильний і могутній. Це {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, який перемагає в кожній битві.

decisions.choice: question and answer at the gate
decisions.reason: The gatekeepers ask who the King is, and the procession answers.

decisions.choice: mighty in battle: the LORD as warrior
decisions.reason: The LORD fights for his people (Exodus 15:3).

decisions.choice: who wins every battle
decisions.reason: Readable says what "mighty in battle" means for the King who enters in triumph.

decisions.choice: gibbor "勇ましい" (L), "勇ましい方" / "勇士" (B), "力のある方" / "勝つ方" (R)
decisions.reason: The LORD is pictured as a warrior (m2); Japanese 勇士 is the Psalter's word for gibbor as a fighter (2 Samuel 22-23).

source.text: שְׂא֤וּ שְׁעָרִ֨ים׀רָֽאשֵׁיכֶ֗ם וּ֭שְׂאוּ פִּתְחֵ֣י עוֹלָ֑ם וְ֝יָבֹא מֶ֣לֶךְ הַכָּבֽוֹד׃

records.literal_gloss: Lift up, gates, your heads, and lift up, doors of antiquity, that may come in [the] King of glory.

en.L: Lift up, gates, your heads, and lift [them] up, ancient doors, that the King of glory may come in!
en.B: Gates, raise your heads high! Raise them, age-old doors, so that the King of glory may enter.
en.R: Open wide, you city gates! Open up, you very old doors! The glorious King is coming in!

fr.L: Portes, élevez vos têtes, et élevez[-les], portails antiques, pour que le Roi de gloire entre !
fr.B: Portes, levez bien haut la tête ! Levez-la, portails des temps anciens, pour que le Roi de gloire puisse entrer.
fr.R: Ouvrez-vous tout grand, portes de la ville ! Ouvrez-vous, vieilles portes ! Le Roi glorieux arrive !

sw.L: Inueni, enyi malango, vichwa vyenu, na [viinueni], enyi milango ya kale, ili Mfalme wa utukufu aingie!
sw.B: Enyi malango, inueni vichwa vyenu juu! Viinueni, enyi milango ya tangu zamani, ili Mfalme wa utukufu aingie.
sw.R: Fungukeni wazi, enyi malango ya mji! Fungukeni, enyi milango ya zamani sana! Mfalme mtukufu anaingia!

es.L: {{plural_you:Levanten|Levantad}}, puertas, {{plural_you:sus cabezas|vuestras cabezas}}, y {{plural_you:levántenlas|levantadlas}}, portones antiguos, ¡para que entre el Rey de la gloria!
es.B: ¡Puertas, {{plural_you:levanten bien alto sus cabezas|levantad bien alto vuestras cabezas}}! {{plural_you:Levántenlas|Levantadlas}}, portones de siglos, para que entre el Rey de la gloria.
es.R: ¡{{plural_you:Ábranse|Abríos}} de par en par, puertas de la ciudad! ¡{{plural_you:Ábranse|Abríos}}, puertas tan antiguas! ¡El Rey glorioso va a entrar!

vi.L: Hỡi các cổng thành, hãy ngẩng đầu lên, và hỡi các cửa xưa cổ, hãy nâng [chúng] lên, để Vua vinh quang tiến vào!
vi.B: Hỡi các cổng thành, hãy ngẩng cao đầu! Hỡi các cửa ngàn xưa, hãy nâng lên, để Vua vinh quang bước vào.
vi.R: Hỡi các cổng thành, hãy mở rộng ra! Hỡi những cánh cửa thật xưa, hãy mở ra! Vị Vua vinh hiển đang tiến vào!

ko.L: 성문들아, 너희 머리를 들어라. 옛 문들아, [머리를] 들어라. 영광의 왕께서 들어가시도록!
ko.B: 성문들아, 머리를 높이 들어라! 오래된 문들아, 머리를 들어라! 영광의 왕께서 들어가실 것이다.
ko.R: 성문들아, 활짝 열려라! 아주 오래된 문들아, 열려라! 영광스러운 왕께서 들어오신다!

pt.L: Levantem, portas, as suas cabeças, e levantem[-nas], entradas antigas, para que entre o Rei da glória!
pt.B: Portas, ergam bem alto as suas cabeças! Ergam-nas, entradas de tempos antigos, para que o Rei da glória possa entrar.
pt.R: Abram-se de par em par, portões da cidade! Abram-se, portas tão antigas! O Rei glorioso vai entrar!

am.L: እናንተ በሮች፣ ራሶቻችሁን አንሡ፤ እናንተ የጥንት መዝጊያዎች፣ [ራሶቻችሁን] አንሡ፤ የክብር ንጉሥ ይገባ ዘንድ!
am.B: በሮች ሆይ፣ ራሶቻችሁን ቀና አድርጉ! የጥንት መዝጊያዎች ሆይ፣ ቀና አድርጓቸው፤ የክብር ንጉሥ እንዲገባ።
am.R: እናንተ የከተማ በሮች፣ በሰፊው ተከፈቱ! እናንተ እጅግ ያረጃችሁ መዝጊያዎች፣ ተከፈቱ! ክቡሩ ንጉሥ እየገባ ነው!

hi.L: हे फाटको, अपने सिर उठाओ, और हे प्राचीन किवाड़ो, [उन्हें] उठाओ, कि महिमा का राजा भीतर आएँ!
hi.B: हे फाटको, अपने सिर ऊँचे उठाओ! हे युगों पुराने किवाड़ो, उन्हें उठाओ, ताकि महिमा का राजा भीतर आ सकें।
hi.R: हे नगर के फाटको, पूरे खुल जाओ! हे बहुत पुराने किवाड़ो, खुल जाओ! महिमामय राजा भीतर आ रहे हैं!

ru.L: Поднимите, ворота, ваши головы, и поднимите [их], древние двери, чтобы вошёл Царь славы!
ru.B: Ворота, поднимите выше головы! Поднимите их, вековые двери, чтобы вошёл Царь славы.
ru.R: Распахнитесь пошире, городские ворота! Откройтесь, очень древние двери! Входит славный Царь!

ja.L: 門よ、頭を上げよ！いにしえの扉よ、[頭を]上げよ！栄光の王が入って来られるために。
ja.B: 門よ、頭を高く上げよ！古くからの扉よ、頭を上げよ！栄光の王が入って来られるように。
ja.R: 町の門よ、大きく開け！とても古い扉よ、開け！栄光に輝く王が入って来られる！

uk.L: Підніміть, брами, ваші голови, і підніміть [їх], вічні двері, щоб увійшов Цар слави!
uk.B: Брами, підніміть високо ваші голови! Підніміть їх, прадавні двері, щоб увійшов Цар слави.
uk.R: Відчиніться навстіж, міські брами! Відчиніться, прадавні двері! Славний Цар входить!

decisions.choice: lift up: the call repeated
decisions.reason: Verse 7 is repeated, now with "lift up" where it had "be lifted up".

decisions.choice: open wide; open up
decisions.reason: As in verse 7.

source.text: מִ֤י ה֣וּא זֶה֮ מֶ֤לֶךְ הַכָּ֫ב֥וֹד יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֑וֹת ה֤וּא מֶ֖לֶךְ הַכָּב֣וֹד סֶֽלָה׃

records.literal_gloss: Who [is] he, this King of glory? YHWH of hosts, he [is] the King of glory. Selah.

en.L: Who [is] {{deity_pronoun:he|He}}, this King of glory? {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} [is] the King of glory. Selah
en.B: Who then is {{deity_pronoun:he|He}}, this King of glory? It is {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is the glorious King. Selah
en.R: Who is this glorious King? It is {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies, who commands the armies of heaven. He is the glorious King! Selah

fr.L: Qui [est-{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}}] donc, ce Roi de gloire ? {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, c’est {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} le Roi de gloire. Sélah
fr.B: Qui est-{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} donc, ce Roi de gloire ? C’est {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées ; c’est {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} le Roi glorieux. Sélah
fr.R: Qui est ce Roi glorieux ? C’est {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, qui commande les armées du ciel. C’est {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} le Roi glorieux ! Sélah

sw.L: Ni nani {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}}, huyu Mfalme wa utukufu? {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} [ndiye] Mfalme wa utukufu. Sela
sw.B: Basi {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} ni nani, huyu Mfalme wa utukufu? Ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa Majeshi; {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} ndiye Mfalme mtukufu. Sela
sw.R: Ni nani huyu Mfalme mtukufu? Ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa Majeshi, anayeamuru majeshi ya mbinguni. Yeye ndiye Mfalme mtukufu! Sela

es.L: ¿Quién [es] {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, este Rey de la gloria? {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} [es] el Rey de la gloria. Selah
es.B: ¿Quién es, pues, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, este Rey de la gloria? Es {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos; {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} es el Rey glorioso. Selah
es.R: ¿Quién es este Rey glorioso? Es {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos, que manda los ejércitos del cielo. ¡Él es el Rey glorioso! Selah

vi.L: Chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, Vua vinh quang này, [là] ai? {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân, chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [là] Vua vinh quang. Sê-la
vi.B: Vậy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là ai, Vua vinh quang này? Đó là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân; chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Vua vinh quang. Sê-la
vi.R: Vị Vua vinh hiển này là ai? Đó là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân, Đấng chỉ huy các đạo quân trên trời. Ngài là Vua vinh hiển! Sê-la

ko.L: 그분, 이 영광의 왕은 누구신가? 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}, 그분이 영광의 왕이시다. 셀라
ko.B: 그렇다면 이 영광의 왕은 누구신가? 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}이시다. 그분이 영광스러운 왕이시다. 셀라
ko.R: 이 영광스러운 왕은 누구신가? 하늘의 군대를 거느리신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}이시다. 그분이 영광스러운 왕이시다! 셀라

pt.L: Quem [é] {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}, este Rei da glória? {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} [é] o Rei da glória. Selá
pt.B: Quem é {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}, então, este Rei da glória? É {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos; {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} é o Rei glorioso. Selá
pt.R: Quem é este Rei glorioso? É {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos, que comanda os exércitos do céu. Ele é o Rei glorioso! Selá

am.L: ይህ የክብር ንጉሥ እርሱ ማን [ነው]? {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ጸባኦት፣ እርሱ የክብር ንጉሥ [ነው]። ሴላ
am.B: ታዲያ ይህ የክብር ንጉሥ ማን ነው? የሠራዊት አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ነው፤ የክብር ንጉሥ እርሱ ነው። ሴላ
am.R: ይህ ክቡር ንጉሥ ማን ነው? የሰማይን ሠራዊት የሚያዝዘው የሠራዊት አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ነው። ክቡሩ ንጉሥ እርሱ ነው! ሴላ

hi.L: वे कौन [हैं], यह महिमा का राजा? सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, वे [ही] महिमा का राजा [हैं]। सेला
hi.B: तो वे कौन हैं, यह महिमा का राजा? वे सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} हैं; वही महिमामय राजा हैं। सेला
hi.R: यह महिमामय राजा कौन है? ये सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} हैं, जो स्वर्ग की सेनाओं के सेनापति हैं। वही महिमामय राजा हैं! सेला

ru.L: Кто {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}}, этот Царь славы? {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Саваоф, {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} — Царь славы. Села
ru.B: Кто же {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}}, этот Царь славы? Это {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Саваоф; {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} — славный Царь. Села
ru.R: Кто этот славный Царь? Это {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Воинств, который повелевает небесными воинствами. Он — славный Царь! Села

ja.B: では、この栄光の王とは、いったいだれか？それは万軍の{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}。その方こそ栄光の王だ。セラ
ja.R: この栄光に輝く王は、だれか？それは、天の軍勢を率いる{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}。その方こそ、栄光に輝く王だ！セラ

uk.L: Хто {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}}, цей Цар слави? {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Саваот — {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} Цар слави. Села
uk.B: Хто ж {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}}, цей Цар слави? Це {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Небесних Військ; {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} — славний Цар. Села
uk.R: Хто цей славний Цар? Це {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Вседержитель, який веде небесні війська. Він — славний Цар! Села

decisions.choice: the LORD of hosts: commander of the armies of heaven
decisions.reason: The hosts (tseva'ot) are armies, the forces of heaven and of Israel (1 Samuel 17:45). The title answers the question with the name of the King: the warrior of verse 8 commands all the powers there are.

decisions.choice: who is he, this: the question pressed harder
decisions.reason: The question of verse 8 is asked again with more stress.

decisions.choice: the LORD of Armies
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the older "hosts"; Balanced and Readable say "Armies", the wording settled for this title across the Old Testament, and Readable adds who the armies are (m1).

decisions.choice: Selah: a word whose meaning is no longer known
alternatives: lift up (the voice or the music)
decisions.reason: Selah stands at the end of a line 71 times in the Psalms and 3 times in Habakkuk 3. It is probably a direction for singing or music, perhaps a pause or an interlude; the ancient Greek translation renders it with a word meaning "interlude". It is not part of what is said, and here it marks a break after the line.

decisions.choice: Selah, kept as it is
decisions.reason: Its meaning is unknown (see the meaning decision on Selah), so every level keeps the word rather than guess, and keeps it apart from the sentence.

decisions.choice: "le SEIGNEUR des armées" at every level
decisions.reason: The title names the LORD as commander of the armies of heaven (m1). French "armées" says this plainly at every level, where English uses the older "hosts" at Literal and "Armies" at Balanced and Readable.

decisions.choice: "BWANA wa majeshi" at Literal; "BWANA wa Majeshi", with a capital, at Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: The title names the LORD as commander of the armies of heaven (m1). "Majeshi" (armies, hosts) says this plainly; Balanced and Readable write it as part of the title, as the English "LORD of Armies" does, and Readable adds who the armies are.

decisions.choice: de los ejércitos (L); de los Ejércitos (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew tsevaʾot means armies: the LORD commands the armies of heaven. Spanish says "de los ejércitos", as the English says "of hosts" at Literal and "of Armies" at Balanced and Readable, where the capital marks it as part of the title.

decisions.choice: "CHÚA Vạn Quân" and "Đức Chúa Trời Vạn Quân" at every level, as James 5:4
decisions.reason: The title names the LORD as commander of the armies of heaven (see the meaning decision). Literal keeps the short traditional "vạn quân" (ten thousand hosts); Balanced and Readable say "the armies" plainly, as the English says "the LORD of Armies".

decisions.choice: "만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}" (L, B); "하늘의 군대를 거느리신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}" (R) for the LORD of hosts
decisions.reason: The title names the LORD as commander of the armies of heaven (meaning decision m1). "만군의" is the established Korean form of the title; Readable says what it means. This is the form for the whole Psalter.

decisions.choice: o SENHOR dos Exércitos (every level)
decisions.reason: The Portuguese Old Testament says "o SENHOR dos Exércitos" for this title at every level (the Old Testament terms list), so Literal does not need the English "hosts"; Readable adds who the armies are, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: the LORD of hosts "{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ጸባኦት" (L), "የሠራዊት አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the terms list for YHWH Tsevaot.

decisions.choice: Selah "ሴላ" at the end of the line
decisions.reason: As in verse 6.

decisions.choice: सेनाओं के प्रभु (every level)
decisions.reason: YHWH of hosts is सेनाओं के प्रभु at every level, as Romans 9:29 and the history books have it; सेनाओं covers both the English Literal "hosts" and the Balanced and Readable "Armies". Readable adds who the armies are, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "ГОСПОДЬ Саваоф" (L, B); "ГОСПОДЬ Воинств" (R)
decisions.reason: The history terms note settles this title (as Romans 9:29 at Literal and Balanced); Psalms keeps it, though the English Balanced already says "Armies".

decisions.choice: YHWH tseva'ot "万軍の{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}" (L, B), "天の軍勢を率いる{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}" (R); for the Psalter
decisions.reason: The LORD of hosts is the commander of heaven's armies (m1); 万軍の主 is the established Japanese title, and Readable explains it as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "ГОСПОДЬ Саваот" (L), "ГОСПОДЬ Небесних Військ" (B), "ГОСПОДЬ Вседержитель" (R) for the LORD of hosts, through the book, as the shared terms note gives it
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew word as a title; Balanced says what the hosts are; Readable uses the familiar title of the ruler of all.
